payload.core_mechanism_summary: Reduce to two independent 1D sequences (by parity) and count ways to fill runs of -1s with no adjacent equal using a DP with aggregated state (eq/neq).
payload.rationale: Solution recognizes odd-length palindromes exist iff some a[i]=a[i+2], so even/odd indices are independent. For each run of -1s bounded by known values or ends, a DP recurrence counts assignments with no adjacent equal, respecting bounds. Classic DP counting.
